raw_posts.name: Templify AI
raw_posts.tagline: Powerful content editor for people who aren’t editors
raw_posts.description: Templify is an all-in-one video, photo, and carousel editor for iPhone. With 1,200+ designer templates, it turns clips and photos into Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and collages in minutes, no timeline needed. Features include AI video editing, beat-synced transitions, auto captions, background removal, filters, and an AI Studio. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription.

raw_posts.name: Filament by Galaxy
raw_posts.tagline: Move data using your terminal or agent. Fast & open source.
raw_posts.description: Filament is a data replication engine written in Go. It supports full loads, incremental replication, and change data capture (CDC). As data moves through the engine, Filament verifies Arrow batches at the sink handoff and, where the sink supports it, checks the exact serialized payload. You can run Filament as a standalone binary or embed it in a Go application.

raw_posts.name: Claude Meetings
raw_posts.tagline: Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk
raw_posts.description: Claude Meetings lets you add Claude to a Google Meet call as a visible participant. The team can ask questions out loud or in chat, and Claude writes the notes and action items so no one on the call has to. It builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts during the call, and teammates on the invite can edit them as you talk. After the call, the notes, transcript, and anything Claude made are on the meeting page in Claude. It is in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, starting with Google Meet.

raw_posts.name: Replicate
raw_posts.tagline: Turn Webflow/Framer app into a Claude/Codex project for free
raw_posts.description: Replicate a Webflow, Framer, or any website-builder project into a NextJS app with 1:1 parity. Migrating off of website builders is difficult due to image CDNs, CMS parity, and minified JS code. Replicate handles all of these problems and commits your code to a GitHub repository. The best part? It's entirely free.

raw_posts.name: Trainn MCP
raw_posts.tagline: Create product videos and courses from any AI chat
raw_posts.description: Give your AI tools the power to create training content, not just plan it. Connect Trainn MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent to turn recordings into product videos, write help articles and build courses through chat. When your product changes, update content through the same conversation. Nothing ships, without your permission.

raw_posts.name: Ganella
raw_posts.tagline: Your Mac Dock, with live widgets for the apps you use
raw_posts.description: Ganella replaces the macOS Dock with a native one where the apps you choose become live widgets: Spotify and Music controls, your calendar, open browser tabs, Xcode builds, terminals and AI agents like Claude, Codex and ChatGPT. raw_posts.name: Google Pixel Tag
raw_posts.description: Google Pixel Tag is a $29.99 item tracker built for Android. Attach it to your keys, wallet, or luggage and find your belongings through Google's Find Hub network of over 1 billion Android devices. Get precise directions with a compatible phone, ring nearby items, or double-press the tag to find your phone, even on silent. Its slim, water-resistant design includes a replaceable battery lasting over a year. Works with Android 9 and newer.
